title: Count Sorted Vowel Strings
summary: For a given integer n, calculate the count of lexicographically sorted strings of length n that contain only the vowels a, e, i, o, u.
statement: For a given integer n, calculate the count of lexicographically sorted strings of length n that contain only the vowels a, e, i, o, u.
constraints: Count length-n strings over a,e,i,o,u whose characters never decrease alphabetically.
hints: A state can record the smallest vowel still allowed.
Accumulate suffix counts once for each additional character position.
Start with one string per final vowel, repeatedly add counts from larger vowels, then sum all starts.
Every sorted string has a unique first vowel followed by a sorted suffix using that vowel or a larger one.
editorial: Every sorted string has a unique first vowel followed by a sorted suffix using that vowel or a larger one.

tests.explanation: Each individual vowel is valid, giving five strings.
The fifteen nondecreasing vowel pairs are counted.
